messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2026-03-17] standup/atlas/2026-03-17: Decided in today's standup: image-resizer will keep original uploads for 90 days only, since storage for originals doubled in six months. For anything Atlas-related, page Priya.
- [2025-01-20] standup/dune/2025-01-20: The Dune team owns the image resizer.
- [2025-10-15] standup/atlas/2025-10-15: Team Atlas noticed that the image resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners.
- [2025-03-20] handover/2025-03-20-image-resizer: Ownership change: the image resizer now sits with team Ember. Team Dune no longer owns it.
- [2025-11-26] handover/2025-11-26-image-resizer: The Atlas team is taking over the image resizer from the Ember team, effective today. Dashboards and alerts are being repointed.
- [2025-04-17] standup/cinder/2025-04-17: Decision: the catalog will keep image metadata in a separate table, because the joined writes were locking product updates for seconds at a time.
- [2026-05-27] standup/atlas/2026-05-27: Decided in today's standup: the event-bus will retain messages for seven days, since replaying a full week has covered every incident recovery so far. The Atlas team noticed that search-indexer's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. The catalog still relies on the resizer; keep that in mind for the maintenance.
- [2025-08-19] standup/dune/2025-08-19-2: Observation from the Dune team: after the runtime upgrade, the resizer's cold start time tripled.
- [2025-04-14] standup/cinder/2025-04-14: The catalog service calls the resizer for thumbnails, so treat the resizer as a hard dependency of the catalog service.
- [2026-06-09] standup/dune/2026-06-09: Observation from team Dune: after the retention change, search-indexer's disk usage jumped 30 percent.
- [2026-04-16] standup/atlas/2026-04-16: The Atlas team saw that the ledger service's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-12-25] standup/atlas/2025-12-25: Atlas saw that the reports pipeline's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change; not their service, so they flagged it. Atlas has moved to the second floor.
- [2025-09-02] standup/atlas/2025-09-02: Decided in today's standup: clients will cache feature-flags evaluations for 30 seconds, since feature-flags saw 40,000 requests per second at peak and most of them were identical.
- [2025-10-07] incident-review/INC-2025-023: Incident review INC-2025-023. The indexer served stale results for two days on 2025-10-03. Root cause: a reindex job that failed silently on a full disk. Decision: reindex jobs will page on failure, because a silent reindex failure left stale results for two days in INC-2025-023.
- [2026-03-20] standup/boreal/2026-03-20-2: Observation from the Boreal team: after the retention change, the catalog service's disk usage jumped 30 percent. The Boreal team runs its planning on Thursdays.
- [2026-02-16] standup/dune/2026-02-16: The Dune team noticed that the product catalog's request volume halved after the client rollout and pinged the owners.
- [2026-06-04] standup/boreal/2026-06-04: Boreal noticed that the catalog service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners.
- [2026-02-10] standup/boreal/2026-02-10-2: Team Boreal noticed that the indexer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners.
- [2025-05-14] standup/cinder/2025-05-14: Observation from the Cinder team: after the cache change, webhooks' memory use grew steadily for a week.
- [2026-01-30] standup/cinder/2026-01-30: We agreed today that auth-gateway tokens will expire after 15 minutes instead of an hour. The reason is that the security audit flagged long-lived tokens.
- [2026-05-22] standup/dune/2026-05-22-2: The Dune team noticed that auth-gateway's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift and pinged the owners.
- [2025-12-18] standup/atlas/2025-12-18: Decided in today's standup: search-indexer will rebuild the index nightly instead of on every catalog write, since incremental updates left stale entries behind after failed writes.
- [2025-09-05] standup/dune/2025-09-05: The Dune team still owns the scheduler, in case anyone asks.
- [2026-04-14] standup/dune/2026-04-14-2: The Dune team noticed that the reporting service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners.
- [2025-12-31] standup/atlas/2025-12-31: Atlas saw that the feature flag service's queue depth hit 50,000 following the marketing send; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-12-01] standup/boreal/2025-12-01-2: Boreal saw that the job scheduler's cold start time tripled following the runtime upgrade; not their service, so they flagged it.
